title: ExplanationRepository
responsibility: Stores reasons outside the source tree until they are persisted as notes.

inputs.name: ExplanationRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: The repository root: git runs here to read the history notes, and the scratch file path is joined onto it. Outside a repository, all() returns only the scratch-file reasons, without an error.

inputs.name: ExplanationRepository.constructor.file
inputs.description: Defaults to explanationsFile: .cache/harness/explanations.ndjson, the scratch store for reasons written before a commit exists. It is joined onto root with path.join, so only undefined selects the default, and any other non-string value makes the constructor throw a TypeError.

inputs.name: ExplanationRepository.append.entries
inputs.description: The explanations to add, each written as one JSON line at the end of the scratch file, whose folder and file are created when missing. Entries are written without a check against explanationSchema, so one that the schema rejects is later skipped by read().

examples.behavior: Appends each entry as one JSON line and creates the scratch folder first.

simplification.attempt: Tried one appendFile call per entry; the single batched call was kept.

performance.attempt: Not measured; the batch is written with one appendFile call.

examples.behavior: Reads the scratch file in order and skips any line that fails explanationSchema.

performance.attempt: Not measured; the scratch file holds one line per reason.

outputs.name: ExplanationRepository.all
outputs.description: Every reason known to the repository: those held in history notes, each once and sorted by recordedAt in UTC and then by serialized text, with a recordedAt that is not a UTC timestamp sorting first; scratch-file reasons follow in file order. A failure to read history notes contributes no reasons, while a failure to read the scratch file rejects the promise.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by the constructor when root is not a string or file is neither undefined nor a string, and rejected by append() when entries is not an array or an entry cannot be serialized to JSON.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem error from creating the scratch folder, reading the scratch file or appending to it, which the code does not catch: read() throws it, and all() and append() reject with it.

outputs.name: ExplanationRepository.constructor
outputs.description: The new ExplanationRepository instance, which keeps root and the scratch path join(root, file) for its methods.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when root is not a string, or when file is neither undefined nor a string, because path.join rejects non-string arguments.
